A 5.1 × 4.6 × 4.3 cm irregular, spiculated mass centered in the posterior segment of the right lower lobe.
A 4.5 cm (max axial dimension) soft‑tissue mass centered in the right hilar region
**Enlarged left upper‑lobe mass** now measuring 6.0 cm
New 3.5 cm spiculated soft‑tissue mass in the posterior segment of the left lower lobe.

candidates.description: The maximum axial dimension of the primary pulmonary lesion as measured by CT imaging.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numerical value of the maximum axial dimension of the primary lung mass in centimeters.
candidates.measurement_definition: Maximum dimension measured in centimeters (cm) using axial CT images.
candidates.name: maximum_primary_tumor_dimension
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the dimension refers to the absolute maximum or only the axial plane across all reports.

candidates.description: The baseline concentration of hemoglobin in the blood.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the numeric value for hemoglobin (Hb or Hgb) reported at baseline in g/dL.
candidates.measurement_definition: Hemoglobin level measured in grams per deciliter (g/dL).
candidates.name: baseline_hemoglobin
candidates.uncertainty: Timing of 'baseline' relative to the start of systemic therapy across different patients.

limitations: Limited number of patients providing a comprehensive set of lab values.
Variability in whether tumor size is reported as a single maximum dimension or a three-dimensional product.
summary: The evidence provides measurable baseline clinical variables for patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), specifically focusing on pulmonary tumor dimensions and baseline hematologic markers.
